title: The Word Of The Guru's Shabad
summary: Self-Worth is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart; those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth
lifeApplication: Let dignity be received before it is defended. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
